newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks seen extending gains at open.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks seen extending gains at open.

text.p: * Toronto's key stock index will likely roll higher at Thursday's open in sympathy with Wall Street stocks.
* Interest-sensitive banks and utilities seen in favor.
Toronto stocks are expected to extend their winning streak after the bell on Thursday, fueled by momentum and a soaring New York market.
"We're probably going to go up in some form of sympathy with New York," one trader said.
Players had one eye on this morning's U.S. jobless claims report. Claims rose slightly to 300,000 in the week of August 2 from a revised 275,000 the previous week.
"I think this is a non-event," said Gerald Vincent, economist at David-Rea Ltd Investment Counsel. Both bond and stock markets will discount the change as non-inflationary.
